Former White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt tried to slam Democratic politicians on Monday, but her numbers didn't add up.

Speaking on a Fox News program, she pointed to Democrats like James Talarico — the party's Senate candidate in Texas — as being "the ultimate hypocrites."

She told host Sean Hannity: "They campaign as moderates, but they do a complete 360 on every single policy position, trying to appeal to common sense, good Americans. And then, when they get elected, they govern as radical, extreme liberal lunatics."

Campaigning as a moderate while doing a "complete 360 on every single policy position" would mean governing as a moderate, since a 360-degree turn lands you exactly where you started.
